messages:
Lena: Quick alignment thread for the competitive messaging refresh and inbound routing for the launch next week. Need: one-pager for SDRs, 3 short battlecard lines, and routing rules that catch benchmark intent. Timebox = 90m.

Marco: I can draft the battlecard bullets. Recommend we lead with: 1) predictable unit economics 2) deployment parity 3) graceful degradation/fallbacks. Keep each line <= 18 words.

Devin: SDR one-pager structure: opener (2 lines), top pain points + rebut (3), qualification questions (3), routing hints (1). I'll prototype it.

Sofia: For webinar soundbites we need p50, p95, and a throughput stat at 4k context. Also a 20-word customer micro-story for the opener.

Karen: Ops can we get a routing prototype that tags leads by intent and priority? We want sdr-bench, ae-enterprise, and solutions queues. Low false positives.

routing-bot: yes. Provide regex patterns and priority order. We'll also log match confidence and original text.

Marco: Example routing rules (prototype):
```
- id: sdr_bench
  pattern: ".*benchmark|latency|p95|throughput|cost per token|unit economics"
  queue: sdr-bench
  priority: 10
- id: ae_enterprise
  pattern: ".*SLA|enterprise|private deployment|VPC|dedicated|reserved"
  queue: ae-enterprise
  priority: 8
- id: solutions
  pattern: ".*on-prem|air-gapped|HSM|compliance|HIPAA|SOC 2"
  queue: solutions
  priority: 9
```

bench-bot: new benchmark uploaded (2026-05-04). Highlights: "~18% lower p50 vs CloudX on dedicated pools with quant Q3"; throughput at 4k context: "~1.4x throughput vs CloudX under continuous batching". Full methodology: https://drive.redwood/benchmarks/2026-05. Please attach methodology caveat to any external claim.

Devin: Important: legal wants every public soundbite to include a one-line caveat: "Measured on dedicated pools; config: quant Q3; see methodology." We'll add that to the one-pager and webinar slides.

Lena: Battlecard 3-sentence knockdowns (first pass):
- CloudX: "Large catalog, but pricing and latency variance at scale." -> Rebut: "Unified runtime + cache/batching controls to stabilize unit economics and meet latency SLOs."
- LLMAPI: "API-first with easy integration, no deployment parity." -> Rebut: "Same API across hosted, dedicated, private; rollout tools and token-level observability."
- InfraCo: "You manage infra; we manage costs." -> Rebut: "Managed inference runtime plus migration playbook and private control plane option for regulated customers."

Marco: Add two short objection scripts (one-liners):
- "We're on CloudX already" -> "Many customers start there; we reduce variance and simplify ops so you can ship faster without re-architecting."
- "We self-host with InfraCo" -> "If you self-host, our private deployment gives you the control you need plus a runtime optimized for production LLM economics."

Sofia: Webinar hooks: 1) 20s customer micro-story: "Dropped p50 by ~20% and cut ops incidents during rollout by half after switching to dedicated pools." 2) Slide soundbites: p50 and throughput with caveat.

Karen: Routing plan: we'll stage the regex in dev today, run 24h of traffic replay, then promote if false positive rate <3%. I'll schedule the smoke window.

Lena: Action items: @Marco finalize battlecard bullets by 11:30 PT, @Devin finalize SDR one-pager + objection scripts by 13:00 PT, @Sofia prepare webinar hooks and attach bench slides, @Karen stage routing and run smoke. Review at 14:00. Thanks everyone :rocket:
